Things after a death
Back-at-camp mode: a share of the backpack falls at the body, goes into a stash at the body (marked on the PDA) or is gone. What the player has on stays with him.
Contusion after a death, min
How long a player who came back is slowed down: blurred vision, less stamina. 0 turns it off.
Money lost on death, %
Share of the player's cash a death takes. 0 turns it off.
Gear wear on death, %
How much condition the weapons in the slots, the armour and the helmet lose when the player comes back.
Rank lost on death, %
Share of the rank (and of a good reputation) a death takes. 0 turns it off.
Kit for a new hardcore character
In hardcore a player who lost his character starts again. Off: with nothing. On: with the kit and the money of his faction.
Show camps to the group
The other players see your camp on their PDA map.
Emergency save every, min
The host saves the world by itself every so many minutes, for an emergency restore. 0 turns it off.
Emergency saves kept
How many of the host's emergency saves are kept; the oldest is overwritten.
